summary: This batch script clears the screen and then runs a Docker container to decrypt a file using AES-256 encryption. It mounts a local Windows directory into the container and uses OpenSSL to decrypt the secrets.encrypted file, outputting the decrypted result.

explanations.1: This disables the echo of commands themselves, so only the command output appears on screen rather than both the commands and their results.
explanations.3: This clears all text from the command prompt window, giving a fresh blank screen.
explanations.5: The --rm flag deletes the container after it finishes running; -it lets you interact with it; -v C:\temp:/data mounts your C:\temp folder inside the container as /data; -w /data sets /data as the working directory. The openssl enc command decrypts the file using a password you'll be prompted to enter.
